BEGIN CASES
===== CASE spec_escapes_on escapes=true =====
----- CONFIG -----
input {
  foo {
    bar => "The computer says, \"No\""
  }
}

----- RESULT -----
----- input -----
  input-foo{"bar" => "The computer says, \"No\""}
----- filter -----
  (Noop)
----- output -----
  (Noop)
===== END =====
===== CASE spec_escapes_off escapes=false =====
----- CONFIG -----
input {
  foo {
    bar => "The computer says, \"No\""
  }
}

----- RESULT -----
----- input -----
  input-foo{"bar" => "The computer says, \\\"No\\\""}
----- filter -----
  (Noop)
----- output -----
  (Noop)
===== END =====
===== CASE spec_empty escapes=false =====
----- CONFIG -----
input {} output {}
----- RESULT -----
----- input -----
  (Noop)
----- filter -----
  (Noop)
----- output -----
  (Noop)
===== END =====
===== CASE spec_simple_plugin escapes=false =====

input { generator {} } 
----- RESULT -----

----- filter -----

----- output -----
  (Noop)
===== END =====
===== CASE spec_mixed_params escapes=false =====
----- CONFIG -----
input { generator { aarg => [1] hasharg => {foo => bar} iarg => 123 farg => 123.123 sarg => 'hello'} } 
----- RESULT -----
----- input -----
  input-generator{"aarg" => [1], "hasharg" => {"foo" => "bar"}, "iarg" => 123, "farg" => 123.123, "sarg" => "hello"}
----- filter -----
  (Noop)
----- output -----
  (Noop)
===== END =====

  (Noop)
===== END =====

===== CASE spec_input_codec escapes=false =====

----- RESULT -----

  (Noop)
----- output -----

===== END =====
===== CASE spec_input_multi_codec escapes=false =====
----- CONFIG -----
input { generator { codec => plain codec => json } } 
----- ERROR -----
LogStash::ConfigurationError: The input plugin generator at line 1 has multiple `codec` declarations - this is not a valid configuration, only one top-level `codec` per input plugin is supported.
===== END =====
===== CASE spec_output_codec escapes=false =====
----- CONFIG -----
input { generator {} } output { stdout { codec => json } }
----- RESULT -----
----- input -----
  input-generator{}
----- filter -----
  (Noop)
----- output -----
  output-stdout{"codec" => "json"}
===== END =====
===== CASE spec_output_multi_codec escapes=false =====
----- CONFIG -----
input { generator {} } output { stdout { codec => plain codec => json } }
----- ERROR -----
LogStash::ConfigurationError: The output plugin stdout at line 1 has multiple `codec` declarations - this is not a valid configuration, only one top-level `codec` per output plugin is supported.
===== END =====
===== CASE spec_grok_merge escapes=false =====
----- CONFIG -----
input { } filter {
    grok {
      match => { "message" => "%{WORD:word}" }
      match => { "examplefield" => "%{NUMBER:num}" }
      break_on_match => false
    }
} output { }

----- RESULT -----
----- input -----
  (Noop)
----- filter -----
  filter-grok{"match" => {"message" => "%{WORD:word}", "examplefield" => "%{NUMBER:num}"}, "break_on_match" => "false"}
----- output -----
  (Noop)
===== END =====
===== CASE spec_grok_dup escapes=false =====
----- CONFIG -----
input { } filter {
    grok {
      match => { "message" => "foo" }
      match => { "message" => "bar" }
      break_on_match => false
    }
} output { }

----- RESULT -----
----- input -----
  (Noop)
----- filter -----
  filter-grok{"match" => {"message" => ["foo", "bar"]}, "break_on_match" => "false"}
----- output -----
  (Noop)
===== END =====
===== CASE spec_nested_hash escapes=false =====
----- CONFIG -----
input { } filter {
    matryoshka {
      key => "%{host}"
      filter_options => {
        string  => "string"
        integer => 3
        nested  => {
          string  => "nested-string"
          integer => 7
          "quoted-key-string" => "nested-quoted-key-string"
          "quoted-key-integer" => 31
          deep    => {
            string  => "deeply-nested-string"
            integer => 127
            "quoted-key-string" => "deeply-nested-quoted-key-string"
            "quoted-key-integer" => 8191
          }
        }
      }
      ttl => 5
    }
} output { }

----- RESULT -----
----- input -----
  (Noop)
----- filter -----
  filter-matryoshka{"key" => "%{host}", "filter_options" => {"string" => "string", "integer" => 3, "nested" => {"string" => "nested-string", "integer" => 7, "quoted-key-string" => "nested-quoted-key-string", "quoted-key-integer" => 31, "deep" => {"string" => "deeply-nested-string", "integer" => 127, "quoted-key-string" => "deeply-nested-quoted-key-string", "quoted-key-integer" => 8191}}}, "ttl" => 5}
----- output -----
  (Noop)
===== END =====

===== CASE spec_filter_if_else escapes=false =====

filter { if [foo] == [bar] { tplugin {} } else { fplugin {} } }
----- RESULT -----

===== END =====
===== CASE spec_filter_if_elsif escapes=false =====
----- CONFIG -----
filter { if [foo] == [bar] { tplugin {} } else if [bar] == [baz] { eifplugin {} } else { fplugin {} } }
----- RESULT -----
----- input -----
  (Noop)
----- filter -----
  (if (event.getField('[foo]')==event.getField('[bar]'))
  filter-tplugin{}
  (if (event.getField('[bar]')==event.getField('[baz]'))
  filter-eifplugin{}
  filter-fplugin{}))
----- output -----
  (Noop)
===== END =====
===== CASE spec_filter_if_elsif_elsif escapes=false =====
----- CONFIG -----
filter {
  if [foo] == [bar] { tplugin {} }
  else if [bar] == [baz] { eifplugin {} }
  else if [baz] == [bot] { eeifplugin {} }
  else { fplugin {} }
}

----- RESULT -----
----- input -----
  (Noop)
----- filter -----
  (if (event.getField('[foo]')==event.getField('[bar]'))
  filter-tplugin{}
  (if (event.getField('[bar]')==event.getField('[baz]'))
  filter-eifplugin{}
  (if (event.getField('[baz]')==event.getField('[bot]'))
  filter-eeifplugin{}
  filter-fplugin{})))
----- output -----
  (Noop)
===== END =====
===== CASE spec_filter_nested_if escapes=false =====
----- CONFIG -----
filter {
  if [foo] == [bar] {
    if [bar] == [baz] { aplugin {} }
  } else {
    if [bar] == [baz] { bplugin {} }
    else if [baz] == [bot] { cplugin {} }
    else { dplugin {} }
  }
}

----- RESULT -----
----- input -----
  (Noop)
----- filter -----
  (if (event.getField('[foo]')==event.getField('[bar]'))
  (if (event.getField('[bar]')==event.getField('[baz]'))
  filter-aplugin{}
  (Noop))
  (if (event.getField('[bar]')==event.getField('[baz]'))
  filter-bplugin{}
  (if (event.getField('[baz]')==event.getField('[bot]'))
  filter-cplugin{}
  filter-dplugin{})))
----- output -----
  (Noop)
===== END =====

output { if ([foo] =~ "\.\.") { aplugin {} } }
----- RESULT -----
----- input -----
  (Noop)
----- filter -----
  (Noop)
----- output -----
  (if (event.getField('[foo]')=~\.\.)
  output-aplugin{}
  (Noop))
===== END =====
===== CASE spec_output_expr_regex_neq escapes=false =====
----- CONFIG -----
output { if ([foo] !~ /^abc$/) { aplugin {} } }
----- RESULT -----
----- input -----
  (Noop)
----- filter -----
  (Noop)
----- output -----
  (if !((event.getField('[foo]')=~^abc$))
  output-aplugin{}
  (Noop))
===== END =====

===== CASE spec_output_if_elsif escapes=false =====
----- CONFIG -----
output { if [foo] == [bar] { tplugin {} } else if [bar] == [baz] { eifplugin {} } else { fplugin {} } }
----- RESULT -----
----- input -----
  (Noop)
----- filter -----
  (Noop)
----- output -----
  (if (event.getField('[foo]')==event.getField('[bar]'))
  output-tplugin{}
  (if (event.getField('[bar]')==event.getField('[baz]'))
  output-eifplugin{}
  output-fplugin{}))
===== END =====
===== CASE spec_output_if_elsif_elsif escapes=false =====
----- CONFIG -----
output {
  if [foo] == [bar] { tplugin {} }
  else if [bar] == [baz] { eifplugin {} }
  else if [baz] == [bot] { eeifplugin {} }
  else { fplugin {} }
}

----- RESULT -----
----- input -----
  (Noop)
----- filter -----
  (Noop)
----- output -----
  (if (event.getField('[foo]')==event.getField('[bar]'))
  output-tplugin{}
  (if (event.getField('[bar]')==event.getField('[baz]'))
  output-eifplugin{}
  (if (event.getField('[baz]')==event.getField('[bot]'))
  output-eeifplugin{}
  output-fplugin{})))
===== END =====
===== CASE spec_output_nested_if escapes=false =====
----- CONFIG -----
output {
  if [foo] == [bar] {
    if [bar] == [baz] { aplugin {} }
  } else {
    if [bar] == [baz] { bplugin {} }
    else if [baz] == [bot] { cplugin {} }
    else { dplugin {} }
  }
}

----- RESULT -----
----- input -----
  (Noop)
----- filter -----
  (Noop)
----- output -----
  (if (event.getField('[foo]')==event.getField('[bar]'))
  (if (event.getField('[bar]')==event.getField('[baz]'))
  output-aplugin{}
  (Noop))
  (if (event.getField('[bar]')==event.getField('[baz]'))
  output-bplugin{}
  (if (event.getField('[baz]')==event.getField('[bot]'))
  output-cplugin{}
  output-dplugin{})))
===== END =====

  (Noop)
===== END =====

===== CASE spec_ast_elsif_multiline escapes=false =====

  }

  (Noop)

  (Noop)
  (Noop)))
----- output -----
  (Noop)
===== END =====

===== CASE spec_ast_comments escapes=false =====
----- CONFIG -----
# early
input # bla
{ # bla
  plugin # bla
  # bla
  { # bla
    # bla
    arg  # bla
    => # bla
    bareword # bla
    # bla
    hasharg => {
      #preentry
      "firstkey" => "firstvalue"
      # bla
      "middle" # bla
      # bla
      => # bla
      # bla
      "midvalue"  # bla
      # bla
      "lastkey" => "lastvalue"
      # bla
    }
  } # bla
# bla
} # bla
# comment ending in EOF:

----- RESULT -----
----- input -----
  input-plugin{"arg" => "bareword", "hasharg" => {"firstkey" => "firstvalue", "middle" => "midvalue", "lastkey" => "lastvalue"}}
----- filter -----
  (Noop)
----- output -----
  (Noop)
===== END =====
